about_the_game:
Experience a fun and relaxing take on the classic bouncing DVD logo screensaver — inspired by the iconic scene from The Office!

This casual idle-style distraction is perfect for easing boredom. Use your mouse to subtly influence the logo’s direction, or simply watch it bounce around the screen. You can even swap in your own image or gif for a personalized touch.

Whether you’re looking for a nostalgic trip down old-school vibes or a low-stress way to unwind during meetings, classes, or wants something different on your stream, cube hits corner delivers lighthearted fun with simple controls and charming visuals.

While it tracks high scores, it’s less of a traditional game and more a playful, customizable screensaver alternative — ideal for anyone wanting a bit of fun reminiscent of the classic office scene turned screensaver. Desktop can still be used like normal while game is running. Can press ESC twice while playing for a fast exit. So no teachers or boss will see you are distracted.
